threads.name: Treasure map
threads.note: Not touched this Session; the map's treasure is still unfound.

threads.name: Dragon hunt (Eric the Reeve's bounty)
threads.note: Sir Phidipaldi obtained Sir Brandon's magic sword (beat_61), a major advance, but the dragon still lives and the rest of the plan in beat_3 remains to be carried out.

threads.name: Fairies appearing more often
threads.note: Not touched this Session; the myth of a fairy-given sword does not bear on why fairies are appearing more often.

threads.name: Ingrid and Warwick (Dunk's deal)
threads.note: Dunk's scheme to get Warwick's mithril shirt remains part of the party's plan (beat_3), and nothing owed under the deal has been done yet.

threads.name: Dr. Uriah's penance for Father William
threads.note: Dr. Uriah visited the Barrow Mound but did no penance or donation, so both obligations remain owed.

threads.name: Squints' share of the treasure
threads.note: The party gathered its first treasure in the mound, but Squints has not yet been given his second pick, so the promise is still owed.

threads.name: Drop Dead Ned's employment
threads.note: The party hired Ned under an ongoing arrangement of kickbacks for murders and bodies, now extended to an offer for the dead goblins that is not yet carried out.

threads.name: The Free Goblin Society deal
threads.note: The party promised to clear the evil from the mound and keep the goblins' presence from King Hogboon in exchange for Brandon's goods (beat_18); the mound is not yet cleared.

threads.name: Brother Dirk and the church's claim on the tomb's relics
threads.note: Dr. Uriah wore Saint Arthur's holy robes over Dirk's objection and Trout deferred Dirk's claim that the chalice belongs to the church, leaving the dispute unsettled.

threads.name: The undead giant in the Barrow Mound
threads.note: A huge undead swordsman matching Alfred from the mosaics has been killing goblins and has just appeared in the tomb doorway, an active danger.

standalone_beats.reason: The recently disturbed door was a notable clue, explained by the goblins' arrival.
The real gemstones in the mosaics are a notable source of wealth left in the mound.
The four virtue statues supplied the answers that later opened Brandon's tomb.
Sir Phidipaldi's blessing of good fortune lasts for the rest of the Barrow Mound adventure.
